theme.title: Five on the Floor

theme.recap: The best numbers come from all over basketball history. Which answer surprised you most?

questions.prompt: How many points per game did Kawhi Leonard score during the Raptors' 2019 playoffs?
questions.context: Toronto · entire 2019 postseason, not just Finals
questions.note: 30.5 per game across Toronto's championship postseason.

funFacts.text: Leonard started every Toronto playoff game and logged 939 minutes during the run.
Toronto rallied from a two-game series deficit by winning four straight against Milwaukee.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: winning the last four games of the series after being down 0–2

funFacts.text: The Raptors became the first team based outside the United States to win the NBA championship.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: first non-US team to win the NBA title

questions.prompt: After an offensive rebound, what is the NBA shot clock reset to?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The shot clock is instead set to 14 following an offensive rebound.

funFacts.text: FIBA introduced the shorter offensive-rebound clock years before the NBA adopted it.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: FIBA adopted this in 2014 and the NBA adopted in 2018

funFacts.text: A defender merely tipping the ball does not restart the clock if the offense keeps possession.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The shot clock does not reset if a defender makes short contact with the ball

funFacts.text: Missing the rim entirely on an airball also leaves the previous countdown running.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: or if a shot attempt misses the rim entirely and airballs

questions.prompt: On March 25, 2016, the Warriors and Mavericks set a record for combined threes in a game. How many?
